messages.Booking confirmation: Hi {name}! You're booked for a {service} on {date} at {time}. Send your inspo pics ahead of time so I can plan the design 💅
messages.Deposit request: Hi {name}! A ${deposit} deposit holds your spot for {date}. It comes off your total. You can send it via {method}.
messages.Day-before reminder: See you tomorrow at {time} for your {service}! Please come with bare nails unless you booked a removal.
messages.No-show policy: Quick reminder of my policy: cancellations under 24 hours or no-shows keep the deposit. Thank you for respecting my time!

messages.Aftercare: Thanks for coming in {name}! Aftercare: use cuticle oil daily, wear gloves for cleaning, and don't pick or bite. Message me if anything lifts within 3 days.
